description: A cardboard box sits near the back of the tabletop, with a pink and a yellow cloth in front and several small rubber toys scattered around. The left hand slides the cloths toward the middle while the right hand gathers the small toys one by one into a cluster, then the right hand repeatedly lifts each toy and tosses it into the cardboard box; after the toys are cleared, the right hand throws the yellow cloth into the box and then throws the pink cloth in as well.
